svg.text: The best level 8 week rose from €9,234 to €29,741 over the weekend
Gross margin of one simulated week, from 3,391 ranked practice weeks and 6 ranking rounds of 5 unseen weeks
Each week is dated by the commit that saved it, Helsinki time. Not counted: unranked weeks, and ts:recall, which replays seeds it remembers.
